name: Carbon
author: E. T. Carter
description: A sheet of carbon fibre in a 2x2 twill weave under a clear coat. Every float is a bundle of parallel fibres with an anisotropic glint, so warp and weft tows brighten under opposite light positions and the checker of highlights flips family by family as a light sweeps across the cloth. Tows bow up and dive under one another with shaded ends and resin seams, fine fibre stripes cross each float, and a broad soft clear-coat reflection rides on top.

params.label: Tow width
params.effect: Width of each tow in CSS px; low is a fine tight weave, high is a coarse close-up of a few tows.

params.label: Sweep speed
params.effect: How fast the light travels across the sheet and the highlight checker flips; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Clear coat
params.effect: Strength of the resin clear-coat reflection; 0 is a dry matte lay-up, high is a wet-look lacquer.

params.label: Fibre grain
params.effect: Visibility of the individual fibre stripes and loose flashing strands; 0 is smooth satin tows.

params.label: Palette tint
params.effect: How much palette colour enters the sheen of the two tow families; 0 is plain grey carbon, 1 is a full two-tone carbon-kevlar.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer pulls the sweeping light across the weave; 0 ignores the mouse.
